sheets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. An original quest inventory pixel-art atlas, square canvas with a rigid invisible 4 columns × 4 rows grid of equal square cells, producing exactly SIXTEEN separated sprites. Each horizontal ROW is a different named item. Its four COLUMNS are four anchored animation phases of that SAME item, facing the same direction, identical shape size and placement. Draw crisp hand-placed square pixels as a handheld RPG item would look in 24×24 native pixels, chunky readable conservative silhouettes, one-pixel deep navy or plum outline, strong flat midtone, highlight and shadow. No smooth gradients, painting, small lettering or copied game assets. Each sprite centered within the middle 65–70% of its cell with TRANSPARENT gutters all around. All empty canvas must be genuine alpha transparency. No canvas color, grid lines, card backgrounds, plaques, text, numbers, shadows or stray sparks. Fit every complete silhouette into its individual cell, all framing identical by column. Four subtly different yet clearly readable glint phases: each frame changes the small lit region on the named feature from one place to the next, in flat 2–3 native pixel clusters. Keep main outlines fixed, no large movement or orbiting particle. Ordered content from TOP ROW to BOTTOM ROW:
ROW 1, Greater Relic of Rejuvenation — Gold healing relic shaped like an unfurling mint herb inside a cream heart clasp; central coral healing spark swells.
ROW 2, Greater Perk: Fortress Stance — Gold-and-steel relic of a squat castle tower shield, two battlements and square cyan slit; slit lights up.
ROW 3, Greater Perk: Riposte — Gold swept guard, thin silver fencing point catching the incoming nick of another blade; one sharp gold contact glint travels.
ROW 4, Greater Perk: Purifying Wave — Golden scallop charm spilling two clean aqua healing waves; white crest alternates bright pixels.
